name: Uranian-Paean
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around crystal cavern networks, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Nothing about the exotic matter deposit appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
